rules.statement: A will is validly attested where a notary public and two witnesses see the testatrix sign, and all four are present together.
rules.supporting_quote: "Since 'attestation' means execution of a deed or will in the presence of witnesses, and 'attesting witness' means a person who has seen a party execute a deed or sign a written agreement, section 3 of the Ordinance No. 7 of 1840 must be construed as dealing only with the authentication and proof of the bare fact of signing by a party."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 3 of the Ordinance No. 7 of 1840
